patch_description: This crossover retains the current program’s two-stage mixing and multiscale CZ hypercube, which produced the strongest worst-group margin, while adopting the inspiration program’s single-parameter regularization and alternating RX/RY parity mixer. All rotations share one parameter, improving parameter efficiency and limiting overfitting. The initial global RY stage provides uniform feature mixing, while the post-entanglement alternating axes add expressivity without increasing the distinct parameter count.
